name: SkySearch
description: Fast, focused search across the records and mods loaded in your Skyrim session

settings.label: Default inventory item count
settings.description: Maximum allowed: 2,140,000,000. You can also adjust the count per search result.

settings.label: Default world spawn count
settings.description: Advised not to go higher than 1 unless you know what you’re doing. Maximum allowed: 100.

settings.label: Maximum results per search
settings.description: A lower limit makes broad searches faster. The native search caps requests at 5,000 records.

settings.label: Show FormIDs in results
settings.description: Display the record FormID under each result name.
